target.title: fix(models): preserve static provider catalog metadata
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Static provider catalog conversion did not preserve all provider/model metadata consistently. The concrete current-main gap is provider-level `params`: static-catalog rows can define provider request params, but the returned runtime model did not merge those provider params with model params.

This PR also makes the static provider catalog converter explicitly carry `compat` and `mediaInput` so the returned runtime model preserves the same schema-valid metadata downstream payload and capability code expects.

## Why This Change Was Made

The runtime should preserve schema-valid provider/model metadata when resolving static provider catalog models. This is a metadata-propagation fix in `modelFromProviderStaticCatalog`; it does not add a new config key, policy path, transport, or custom-provider tool API.

Reviewer scope:
- This PR proves static provider catalog params/metadata propagation into the resolved runtime model and OpenAI-compatible request params.
- The proof is intentionally scoped away from the separate live-session `Tool exec not found` issue, which is not evidence for or against this metadata path.
- Current main already keeps normal configured-provider compat flowing in other paths, and tools are permissive unless `compat.supportsTools === false`; the changed path here is static provider catalog conversion.

## User Impact

Users and bundled/provider catalogs can define provider-level request params and model metadata without losing that metadata during static provider catalog model resolution. Downstream payload generation and capability checks then receive the resolved model shape consistently.

## Evidence

Behavior or issue addressed:
- Static provider catalog conversion merges provider-level and model-level `params`, with model-level values taking precedence.
- Static provider catalog conversion preserves model `compat` metadata.
- Static provider catalog conversion preserves model `mediaInput` metadata.
- Scoped CLI proof shows merged static provider catalog params reaching the resolved runtime model and then OpenAI completions request params.
- Regression coverage verifies that a resolved model with `compat.supportsTools=true` remains tool-capable through `supportsModelTools(model)`.
- Regression coverage verifies that OpenAI completions payload construction keeps tool definitions when the resolved model metadata says tools are supported.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
```text
git fetch upstream main --prune
git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...upstream/main
sh -c 'git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD; printf "base_is_ancestor_of_head=%s\n" "$?"'
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts
node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts
node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts
node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts --reporter verbose
gh run list -R openclaw/openclaw --branch fix/custom-provider-supports-tools --limit 12 --json databaseId,workflowName,status,conclusion,headSha
gh run view 29041838930 -R openclaw/openclaw --log
```

Branch freshness check:
```text
$ git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...upstream/main
2	784

$ sh -c 'git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD; printf "base_is_ancestor_of_head=%s\n" "$?"'
base_is_ancestor_of_head=1
```

Interpretation:
- The PR branch is currently behind `main` because upstream advanced after the branch was cut.
- `base_is_ancestor_of_head=1` means the current upstream base is not contained in this branch, which explains GitHub's "This branch is out-of-date with the base branch" banner.
- GitHub still reports the PR as cleanly mergeable; this is a freshness/merge-policy banner, not a conflict banner.

Scoped CLI metadata propagation proof:
```text
$ node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts --reporter verbose

STATIC_PROVIDER_CATALOG_METADATA_PROOF {
  "provider": "proof-provider",
  "id": "proof-model",
  "api": "openai-completions",
  "baseUrl": "https://redacted.example/v1",
  "params": {
    "max_completion_tokens": 64000,
    "providerDefault": true,
    "modelDefault": true
  },
  "compat": {
    "supportsTools": true,
    "maxTokensField": "max_completion_tokens"
  },
  "mediaInput": {
    "image": {
      "maxSidePx": 3072,
      "tokenMode": "provider"
    }
  },
  "transport": {
    "headers": {
      "X-Static-Catalog": "redacted"
    }
  },
  "request": {
    "model": "proof-model",
    "max_completion_tokens": 64000,
    "tools": "absent"
  }
}

 ✓ |agents| src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/proof-static-catalog-metadata.test.ts > redacted static provider catalog metadata proof > preserves provider/model metadata into resolved runtime and request params 185ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
   Start at  15:07:22

```

What this proves:
- Provider-level `params.max_completion_tokens=32000` and model-level `params.max_completion_tokens=64000` were merged by the static provider catalog resolver, with the model-level value winning.
- The resolved runtime model preserved provider/model params, `compat`, `mediaInput`, and request transport headers.
- `buildOpenAICompletionsParams(...)` consumed the resolved runtime model and emitted `max_completion_tokens: 64000`, proving the metadata reached the request payload path.
- The proof did not exercise or depend on live tool execution, and does not use the separate `Tool exec not found` session issue as evidence.

Targeted regression coverage added:
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.static-catalog.test.ts`: static catalog model conversion preserves `compat`, `mediaInput`, and merged `params`.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/model.test.ts`: resolved model `compat.supportsTools=true` remains tool-capable through `supportsModelTools(model)`.
- `src/agents/openai-transport-stream.test.ts`: OpenAI completions payload keeps the `exec` tool when model compat sets `supportsTools=true`.

Verification caveat:
- A later live gateway smoke rerun did **not** prove actual tool execution; it exposed a separate live session/tool exposure issue where the runtime returned `Tool exec not found`. That output is intentionally not used as proof for this PR.
